summary: In July 1909 the Board refused S. J. Hi permission to run a laundry at 1018 Pine Street. Five months earlier it had granted one to Lee Hee on Geary, and the year after it granted two more, to Jean Paihle on Mason Street and to Nogue and Jaymot on Austin. Twice in 1910 it let contractors set off blasts on the Olympic Club's site on Post Street to get the old foundations out, and in 1913 it ordered the pipework for a 750,000-gallon concrete tank to be sunk into the hill between Le Roy Place and Jones Street.
